The east gate passes to Ah Muk after Chan Bok’s race card, the saddle leather and three keys; the mystery ends as an instruction, not an exposition dump. Six real StateGraphs run in the service (world guide, Ah Wan NPC, analyst readout, EN-arm drafting bench, fenced arc auditor, on-demand story recap). The io surface carries real GitHub REST byte measurements and real repository counts only.

§十一 pressure re-verified on the production build: 640 requests @ 32-way across five routes, zero failures/timeouts/5xx; Next dev compile latency ruled out as a capacity issue; local :3002 NEXUS plane, :3000 belongs to an unrelated stack.

Self-hosted Windows runner online; ci-local gates verify_all + fold + typecheck + vitest; hosted CI stays backlogged — local gates remain authoritative. No secret ever committed; the live key/base/proxy live in gitignored env files only.
